'''Omi Vane''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] and a member of the [[House of Vane]], was the wife of [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] who died around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Unfortunately, her husband chose to join the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the side of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] until he realized that [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had killed his [[Harko Vane|father]] and was eventually killed during the [[Battle of the Veil Nebula]], leaving Omi a widow and subsequently the Queen of Valahari.
